title: WeightBridge: An Efficient Weight Transfer Library for Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.25442v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Weight transfer - the propagation of updated parameters from trainers to rollout generators - is becoming an important performance bottleneck in reinforcement learning (RL) systems for LLMs. The central challenge is supporting the diverse trainer and rollout layouts and synchronization requirements of modern RL workloads without sacrificing efficiency. Existing solutions are efficient under some configurations but perform poorly or lack support under others. We present WeightBridge, a flexible, efficient weight-transfer library designed to deliver high performance across diverse RL configurations. WeightBridge first automatically extracts the correspondence between trainer and rollout weight layouts, then plans and executes redundancy-free and load-balanced weight transfer. translated_title: WeightBridge：一个面向强化学习的高效权重传输库
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.25442v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：权重传输——即将更新后的参数从训练器传播到 rollout 生成器——正在成为面向大语言模型的强化学习（RL）系统中一个重要的性能瓶颈。其核心挑战在于，如何在不牺牲效率的前提下，支持现代 RL 工作负载中多样化的训练器与 rollout 布局以及同步需求。现有解决方案在某些配置下效率较高，但在其他配置下表现不佳或缺乏支持。我们提出了 WeightBridge，一个灵活、高效的权重传输库，旨在跨多种 RL 配置实现高性能。WeightBridge 首先自动提取训练器与 rollout 权重布局之间的对应关系，然后规划并执行无冗余且负载均衡的权重传输。它提供一个小型、通用的 API，同时协调跨多种同步模式的工作进程。在跨越不同模型、并行化布局（摘要在此处截断）……的配置中
tldr: WeightBridge 是一个面向大语言模型强化学习系统的高效权重传输库，它通过自动提取训练器与 rollout 权重布局之间的对应关系，规划并执行无冗余、负载均衡的权重传输，从而在多种模型、并行化布局和同步模式下都能保持高性能。
en_tdlr: WeightBridge is an efficient weight-transfer library for LLM reinforcement learning systems that automatically extracts the correspondence between trainer and rollout weight layouts and executes redundancy-free, load-balanced weight transfers, achieving high performance across diverse models, parallelization layouts, and synchronization modes.
